releaseNotes: Flashy v2.21 (FG fixes pack ka APK hissa + History redesign): (1) Phases sirf Disable/Enable hotay hain, delete kabhi nahi; PACKING live disabled; History mein sirf enabled phases. (2) Tank auto-code (T-1/F-9) khatam — har tank ka naam user deta hai, creation par poochha jata hai, kabhi bhi rename; rename usi phase ka jis par koi consumption nahi. (3) Mega menu (⋮) screen ke top-right par; tamam popups backdrop tap se band; footer = Mega left, phases center, ⋮ right. (4) History two-level: plans list / items list → detail; plan detail mein Edit + Print upar, items tartib se, har phase rang wali sticky patti ke neeche apni total ke saath; item detail plan-wise grouped. (5) Print popup mein zoom in/out + % reset; mobile par Save PDF/PNG/CSV ka bug fix — downloads ab native AndroidFileSaver bridge se Downloads/Flashy mein save hotay hain. (6) Tank graphic se 'Tank … • PHASE' boilerplate khatam, sirf naam ki saaf chip. (7) Loader system: rectangle panel + plain spinner khatam — branded loader, skeleton cards, pulsing dots, export progress bar + button Saving state. (8) Desktop Advance Request + Advance Sheet ka naya design (functionality same).
